newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Ministers warn environment could clash with WTO rules.
newsitem.headline: Ministers warn environment could clash with WTO rules.

text.p: A Swedish request to integrate environmental issues more closely into European Union agricultural policy was met with a warning that it may lead to a clash in the World Trade Talks, an EU offcial said on Monday.

"The Swedish farm minister made a request that the two issues should be brought more closely into line but several ministers warned that it could distort competition under World Trade Rules," the spokesman said after Farm Council talks.
Farm Commissioner Franz Fischler said he regretted that the November Cork declaration on rural development was not included in the conclusions of the European Council in Dublin.
It was dropped after several member states called for more discussions to ensure that the Common Agricultural Policy (CAP) was safeguarded.
